title: Entity Detector
description: A Creeper has nuke your home? Install a detector and fight back!
body:
Mod Recreation of Entity Detector

Original mod made by neocromicon. The mod was a lost media.

# Main function

The mod adds blocks capable of detecting entities around them, you can select the distance from 3 to 8 blocks.

They are 4 types of blocks:
- All entities
- Animals
- Mobs
- Players

# Permission

I asked to the original creator if public upload is allowed.
